entries.title: Job 3:1
segments: ¶Then, opening his mouth, and cursing the day of his birth,

entries.title: Job 3:2
segments: Job made answer and said,

entries.title: Job 3:3
segments: Let destruction take the day of my birth, and the night on which it was said, A man child has come into the world.

entries.title: Job 3:4
segments: That day--let it be dark; let not God take note of it from on high, and let not the light be shining on it;

entries.title: Job 3:5
segments: Let the dark and the black night take it for themselves; let it be covered with a cloud; let the dark shades of day send fear on it.

entries.title: Job 3:6
segments: That night--let the thick dark take it; let it not have joy among the days of the year; let it not come into the number of the months.

entries.title: Job 3:7
segments: As for that night, let it have no fruit; let no voice of joy be sounded in it;

entries.title: Job 3:8
segments: Let it be cursed by those who put a curse on the day; who are ready to make Leviathan awake.

entries.title: Job 3:9
segments: Let its morning stars be dark; let it be looking for light, but may it not have any; let it not see the eyes of the dawn.

entries.title: Job 3:10
segments: Because it did not keep the doors of my mother's body shut, so that trouble might be veiled from my eyes.

entries.title: Job 3:11
segments: ¶Why did death not take me when I came out of my mother's body, why did I not, when I came out, give up my last breath?

entries.title: Job 3:12
segments: Why did the knees take me, or why the breasts that they might give me milk?

entries.title: Job 3:13
segments: For then I might have gone to my rest in quiet, and in sleep have been in peace,

entries.title: Job 3:14
segments: With kings and the wise ones of the earth, who put up great houses for themselves;

entries.title: Job 3:15
segments: Or with rulers who had gold, and whose houses were full of silver;

entries.title: Job 3:16
segments: Or as a child dead at birth I might never have come into existence; like young children who have not seen the light.

entries.title: Job 3:17
segments: There the passions of the evil are over, and those whose strength has come to an end have rest.

entries.title: Job 3:18
segments: There the prisoners are at peace together; the voice of the overseer comes not again to their ears.

entries.title: Job 3:19
segments: The small and the great are there, and the servant is free from his master.

entries.title: Job 3:20
segments: ¶Why does he give light to him who is in trouble, and life to the bitter in soul;

entries.title: Job 3:21
segments: To those whose desire is for death, but it comes not; who are searching for it more than for secret wealth;

entries.title: Job 3:22
segments: Who are glad with great joy, and full of delight when they come to their last resting-place;

entries.title: Job 3:23
segments: To a man whose way is veiled, and who is shut in by God?

entries.title: Job 3:24
segments: In place of my food I have grief, and cries of sorrow come from me like water.

entries.title: Job 3:25
segments: For I have a fear and it comes on me, and my heart is greatly troubled.

entries.title: Job 3:26
segments: I have no peace, no quiet, and no rest; nothing but pain comes on me.
